description: Add, modify or delete an IPA HBAC rule using IPA API.

parameters.name: cn
parameters.description: Canonical name. Can not be changed as it is the unique identifier.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: List of host names to assign. If an empty list is passed all hosts are removed from the rule. If option is omitted hosts are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: hostcategory
parameters.description: Host category. Choices: "all"

parameters.name: hostgroup
parameters.description: List of hostgroup names to assign. If an empty list is passed all hostgroups are removed from the rule. If option is omitted hostgroups are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: ipa_host
parameters.description: IP or hostname of IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_HOST is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_HOST and the value are not specified in the task, then DNS is used to try to discover the FreeIPA server. The relevant entry needed in FreeIPA is the ipa-ca entry. If neither the DNS entry, nor the environment IPA_HOST, nor the value are available in the task, then the default value is used. Default: "ipa.example.com"

parameters.name: ipa_pass
parameters.description: Password of administrative user. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PASS is used instead. Note that if the urllib_gssapi library is available, it is possible to use GSSAPI to authenticate to FreeIPA. If the environment variable KRB5CCNAME is available, the module uses this Kerberos credentials cache to authenticate to the FreeIPA server. If the environment variable KRB5_CLIENT_KTNAME is available, and KRB5CCNAME is not; the module uses this Kerberos keytab to authenticate. If GSSAPI is not available, the usage of ipa_pass is required.

parameters.name: ipa_port
parameters.description: Port of FreeIPA / IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PORT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PORT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 443

parameters.name: ipa_prot
parameters.description: Protocol used by IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_PROT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_PROT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: ipa_timeout
parameters.description: Specifies idle timeout (in seconds) for the connection. For bulk operations, you may want to increase this in order to avoid timeout from IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_TIMEOUT and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: 10

parameters.name: ipa_user
parameters.description: Administrative account used on IPA server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable IPA_USER is used instead. If both the environment variable IPA_USER and the value are not specified in the task, then default value is set. Default: "admin"

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: List of service names to assign. If an empty list is passed all services are removed from the rule. If option is omitted services are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: servicecategory
parameters.description: Service category. Choices: "all"

parameters.name: servicegroup
parameters.description: List of service group names to assign. If an empty list is passed all assigned service groups are removed from the rule. If option is omitted service groups are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: sourcehost
parameters.description: List of source host names to assign. If an empty list if passed all assigned source hosts are removed from the rule. If option is omitted source hosts are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: sourcehostcategory
parameters.description: Source host category. Choices: "all"

parameters.name: sourcehostgroup
parameters.description: List of source host group names to assign. If an empty list if passed all assigned source host groups are removed from the rule. If option is omitted source host groups are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State to ensure. Choices: "absent" "disabled" "enabled" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: List of user names to assign. If an empty list if passed all assigned users are removed from the rule. If option is omitted users are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: usercategory
parameters.description: User category. Choices: "all"

parameters.name: usergroup
parameters.description: List of user group names to assign. If an empty list if passed all assigned user groups are removed from the rule. If option is omitted user groups are not checked or changed.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: This only applies if ipa_prot is https. If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Ensure rule to allow all users to access any host from any host
  community.general.ipa_hbacrule:
    name: allow_all
    description: Allow all users to access any host from any host
    hostcategory: all
    servicecategory: all
    usercategory: all
    state: present
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure rule with certain limitations
  community.general.ipa_hbacrule:
    name: allow_all_developers_access_to_db
    description: Allow all developers to access any database from any host
    hostgroup:
      - db-server
    usergroup:
      - developers
    state: present
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

- name: Ensure rule is absent
  community.general.ipa_hbacrule:
    name: rule_to_be_deleted
    state: absent
    ipa_host: ipa.example.com
    ipa_user: admin
    ipa_pass: topsecret

return_values.name: hbacrule
return_values.description: HBAC rule as returned by IPA API. Returned: always
